title: MA60017: Statistical Methods
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Fundamental concepts of probability, random variables and mathematical
expectation, some discrete and continuous probability distributions, joint
probability distributions, sampling distributions, estimation and hypothesis
testing, correlation and regression, analysis of variance (one- way and twoway classifications).
